tools.name: search_laravel_jobs
tools.description: Search recent Laravel jobs indexed by LaraBench. Results are limited to the last 7 days and link to LaraBench job pages.

tools.name: search_laravel_news
tools.description: Search recent Laravel ecosystem news and package releases indexed by LaraBench. Results are limited to the last 7 days and link to LaraBench news pages.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_laravel_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search recent Laravel jobs indexed by LaraBench. Results are limited to the last 7 days and link to LaraBench job pages." → after: "Search recent Laravel jobs indexed by LaraBench, including full description, salary, seniority, and employment type. Results are limited to the last 30 days. Each job carries a LaraBench detail page and, when the source published one, the original apply URL."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_laravel_news" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search recent Laravel ecosystem news and package releases indexed by LaraBench.
